summary: This policy from Titan Innovations sets out the company's commitment to employee professional development, centered on skill development and in-house training sessions. It states that all employees have equal access to learning opportunities, while the responsibility for learning and applying new skills rests with each employee. The company promises support such as paid training time, online courses and external workshops, and gathers feedback to improve its programs.
one_line: Titan Innovations' policy committing to employee skill development through in-house training, equal access, company-provided resources, and employee ownership of growth.
key_facts: Titan Innovations says its team is its strongest asset and that investing in their skills is investing in the foundation of the company.
The policy focuses on employee skill development and in-house training sessions.
Titan Innovations' philosophy holds that mastery is not a destination, but a never-ending journey.
The company regularly conducts in-house training sessions to bridge skills gaps and promote a culture of learning.
In-house training covers technical skills that keep teams at the vanguard of innovation and soft skills that enhance collaboration and leadership.
Every Titan Innovations employee, regardless of position or tenure, has access to professional development opportunities.
Learning and development programs are inclusive and designed to cater to various learning styles and needs.
Titan Innovations states that the onus of learning and applying new skills rests with each employee, who is expected to take ownership of their own growth.
The company commits to time allocated during work hours for training, access to online courses, and external workshops when relevant.
Titan Innovations ensures staff have the opportunity to put new skills into practice and to receive feedback that aids their development.
The company regularly solicits employee feedback, describing a two-way conversation as essential for continual improvement of training programs.
Titan Innovations describes professional development as a promise made to both its employees and its clients.
The company aims to build a community of lifelong learners armed with the skills to lead tomorrow's industry standards.

entities.name: Titan Innovations
entities.role: Company that issues the professional development policy and commits to supporting employee growth
